scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && concurrently -n db,server,client -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev:db --workspace=packages/server" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/server" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/server && npm run build --workspace=packages/client && npm run build --workspace=packages/bsr
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/shared && npm run test --workspace=packages/bsr
scripts.migrate: npm run build --workspace=packages/server && npm run migrate --workspace=packages/server
